title: Astro Portal API v1 sky brightness by direction
description: GET /v1/sky-quality/direction query and response (packages/portal/src/planner/sky-quality.server.js `loadPlannerSkyDirection`; packages/portal-app/src/routes/api/v1/sky-quality/direction/route.js). Public read, like GET /v1/sky-quality: a present Authorization header must still be a valid device bearer. The ESTIMATED sky brightness, in mag/arcsec², by altitude and azimuth around a place, computed by `skyBrightnessByDirection` (packages/portal/src/sky-quality-direction.js, model `line-of-sight-v1`) from the installed VIIRS-derived raster. The coordinates are rounded to 0.01° before computing and never echoed back. `sqm[i][j]` is the value at `altitudes[i]` and azimuth `j × azimuthStepDegrees` (0 = north, 90 = east). The grid is derived data: a client may keep it per place and per `rasterChecksum`, never synchronizes it and never writes it into a plan. Without an installed raster the route answers 503 `sky_quality_unavailable` with Retry-After, exactly like GET /v1/sky-quality.

rasterChecksum.description: The installed raster's checksum (its manifest's `checksum`). A cached grid whose checksum differs from the current raster's is recomputed.
